subject: Renewal kickoff — timeline, term/capacity changes, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acmecorp.com>, John Torres <john.torres@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff — timeline, term/capacity changes, and QBR scheduling

Hi Sarah / John —

Thanks again for the continued partnership — excited to kick off the renewal and expansion planning for Acme. High level items we should align on in the next 30–60 days:

- Term: Acme has expressed interest in moving to a 24-month commitment in exchange for a blended unit discount.
- Capacity: proposal to add +2 Dedicated GPU workers to your pool and raise monthly committed tokens by ~500k to cover Q2 load.
- Commercials: updated pricing worksheet + mutual action plan attached for initial review.
- Compliance: we will include the SOC2 attestation and audit log export options; Sarah asked for evidence — will attach separately.

Proposed timeline:
- Jan 15–Jan 23: confirm stakeholders & baseline metrics (current spend, peak QPS, cache hit rate)
- Jan 24–Feb 7: finalize pricing/term/contract redlines + internal approvals
- Feb 8–Feb 12: Renewal QBR (schedule below) and exec sign-off window
- Feb 15: target PO/DocuSign completion and start of renewed billing term (if possible)

Please confirm the right people on your side for procurement, legal and engineering validation. We also want to schedule a 60-minute Renewal QBR to review capacity needs, SLOs, and rollout plan. I have the week of Feb 8–12 open; proposed slot: Feb 10 at 11:00 AM ET.

Attachments: Renewal_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, Draft_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (stubs)

Next steps:
1) Sarah/John — confirm stakeholders and the Feb 10 slot or propose alternatives
2) Rishi — can you prepare an updated capacity impact note (latency/throughput) for the +2 GPUs by Jan 20?
3) Vivek/Laura — please flag any special commercial constraints (billing cadence, PO process)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call today if helpful.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this looks good.

Quick notes from our side:
- Please include procurement (looping John) and our security lead for the SOC2 artifacts.
- Feb 10 at 11:00 AM ET works for us for the QBR; please send a calendar invite.
- John will want a simple pricing breakdown (line items for base committed capacity, overage, and add-on Dedicated GPUs) and the SOC2 report before the QBR.
- Acme is also interested in a custom SLO discussion — our ops team will join for that portion.

Also: can you confirm whether the 24-month term is required to get the proposed discount, or if a 12-month with a stepped ramp would also qualify?

Sarah

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-01-17T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal kickoff —pricing/discount guardrails + prep call

Looping in finance ops thoughts — a few internal points for the thread:

- Discounting: for a 24-month commitment we can offer a blended 18% discount off list on base committed tokens and a capacity credit for the Dedicated workers. 12-month with ramp: ~10% with staged pricing at months 1–6/7–12. We should confirm whether Acme prefers predictability (24mo) or flexibility (12mo).
- Billing: Acme historically prefers Net 30 and issues POs. Laura, please prepare a quick checklist for John (required billing fields, invoice remit address, and PO reference).
- Pre-call: recommend a 30-minute internal prep on Feb 9 at 10:00 AM PT to align talking points and owner handoffs.

I will attach the current pricing workbook (ACME_Renewal_Pricing_v1.pdf) to the internal prep calendar invite.

Thanks — Vivek
